title.narrative: Program Monitoring & Evaluation in the Ministry of Agriculture & Food (MAF) IDF Grant

description.narrative: TF053393 On 12/19/2003 the ECA IDF Committee approved a grant in the amount of $250comma000. The IDF Grant will support to develop the monitoring and evaluation and reporting capacity of the Georgia Ministry of Agriculture and Food (MAF). The MAF is an important line Ministry in Georgia in terms of institutional and governance reformcomma providing a model for other Ministries in an environment rife with corruption' and mismanagement. Over the last few years the MAF has (i) adopted an outward lookingcomma market orientedcomma strategic agricultural sector development framework; (ii) with USAID and World Bank project supportcomma it has invested in its internal financial control and audit systems; (iii) is planning a comprehensive institutional restructuring program; and (iv) is implementingcomma with Bank and EU TACIS supportcomma a program to introduce international accounting standards to its financial management units. As suchcomma the MAF can act as a model for much need improvements in governancecomma financial control and accountability across public sector organizations in Georgia. Building on MAF's reform agendacomma this IDF investment will contribute significantly to the Ministry's capacity to monitor and report on its programs. Improving information flows will also assist the coherence of MAFs activities and its accountability to the citizenry of Georgia.
